name: Custom Character (Tav)
title: The Blank Slate Adventurer
quote: No gods, no masters, just a sharp rapier and a silver tongue.

uniqueFeature.name: Unrestricted Choice
uniqueFeature.description: Full freedom to pick any race, background, dialogue personality, and ability score distribution without canonical constraints.

optimizationRationale: College of Swords unlocks Slashing Flourish (Ranged), which fires two attacks per attack action. With Extra Attack at level 6, a single action unleashes 4 hits. Equipping the Helmet of Arcane Acuity stacks +2 Spell Save DC per hit up to the maximum cap of +10 DC in turn 1. The Band of the Mystic Scoundrel allows casting Enchantment and Illusion spells (such as Hold Person, Hold Monster, or Command: Grovel) as a bonus action immediately following weapon attacks, ensuring an unbreakable 100% success rate on Honor Mode bosses. Adding 1 level of Fighter grants archery fighting style, shield proficiency, and Constitution saving throw proficiency, while 1 level of Wizard unlocks scribing any scroll in the game up to 6th level.

combatLoopBreakdown.bonusAction: Band of the Mystic Scoundrel bonus action: cast 100% DC Hold Monster, Hold Person, or Command
combatLoopBreakdown.reaction: Shield spell (+5 AC) or Counterspell to deny enemy legendary spells

Exceptional dialogue mastery with Bard expertise in Persuasion and Deception

drawbacks: Vulnerable if disarmed or silenced before building Arcane Acuity stacks
Mystic Scoundrel ring is in Act 3 Circus: requires early-game patience
Consumes Bardic Inspiration charges rapidly in multi-wave battles

title: The Pale Elf

uniqueFeature.name: Vampiric Bite (Happy Buff)
uniqueFeature.description: Bonus action bite granting the Happy status (+1 to all attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks until long rest). Act 3 Ascension adds +1d10 necrotic damage to all attacks.

recommendedMulticlass: 8 Open Hand Monk / 4 Thief Rogue (or 5 Gloom Stalker / 4 Assassin / 3 Battle Master)
optimizationRationale: Astarion's unique Vampire Bite inflicts the Bloodless condition and grants the Happy buff (+1 to all attack rolls, saving throws, and skill checks until long rest). Act 3 Ascension injects a flat +1d10 necrotic damage to all unarmed and weapon strikes. Combining Tavern Brawler with Open Hand Monk adds double Strength modifier (+10 to hit and damage) to unarmed strikes. 4 levels of Thief Rogue provide Fast Hands (2 bonus actions every turn). Each bonus action executes Flurry of Blows (two strikes), resulting in 6 unarmed strikes per turn dealing well over 220 damage, toppling bosses with no resource expenditure.

combatLoopBreakdown.bonusAction: Fast Hands provides 2 bonus actions: Flurry of Blows (Topple) followed by Flurry of Blows (Stagger)

name: Shadowheart
title: Daughter of Darkness
quote: Lady Shar, guide my hands. Or Selûne, whoever is listening.

uniqueFeature.name: Selûne / Shar Equipment Convergence
uniqueFeature.description: Unique narrative access to Shar's Spear of Evening (Darkness blindness immunity) or Selûne's Spear of Night (Moonbeam and Moonmote).

recommendedMulticlass: 12 Light Cleric (or 11 Life Cleric / 1 Storm Sorcerer)
optimizationRationale: Spirit Guardians (Radiant) turns Shadowheart into a mobile area denial storm. Equipping Luminous Armor applies Radiating Orb on radiant damage hits, inflicting up to -10 to all enemy attack rolls in a wide perimeter. Coruscation Ring and Callous Glow Ring apply additional radiant damage ticks and Radiating Orb stacks. Boots of Stormy Clamour apply Reverberation whenever a condition is inflicted, tripping enemies prone with zero action cost. Respeccing to Light Cleric grants Radiance of the Dawn (channel divinity AoE incinerating hordes) and Warding Flare to impose disadvantage on enemy attack rolls.

combatLoopBreakdown.bonusAction: Mass Healing Word (triggers Whispering Promise team-wide Bless and Hellrider's Pride Blade Ward)
combatLoopBreakdown.reaction: Warding Flare imposes disadvantage on incoming attacks targeting Shadowheart or nearby allies

strengths: Neutralizes enemy offensive threat by stacking -1 to -10 attack penalties on all nearby foes
Radiance of the Dawn vaporizes swarms of Act 2 undead without expending spell slots
Warding Flare reaction imposes disadvantage on attack rolls targeting Shadowheart or allies
drawbacks: Vulnerable to Radiant Retort (such as Sharran Sanctuary in Act 3) which redirects 200% damage back
Heavy Long Rest dependency: burning spell slots on Spirit Guardians drains supplies
Lacks martial weapon proficiency without racial or feat investment

strengths: Near-impossible for the party to wipe: huge reactive AoE healing resets low HP emergencies
Every heal distributes 2 turns of Blade Ward (50% physical resistance) and 1d4 Bless to attack/saves
Heavy armor and shield proficiency allows reaching 22+ AC with minimal equipment conflict
drawbacks: Lower personal offensive DPR compared to Light Cleric or Tempest Cleric
Can lead to passive play if encounters do not stress party health pools
Requires 1 level in Storm Sorcerer to solve Cleric mobility deficits

Invoke Duplicity clone grants permanent attack advantage to martial allies in a 3m radius
Domain spells include Dimension Door and Polymorph for high exploratory utility
drawbacks: Channel Divinity Invoke Duplicity requires concentration, competing directly with Spirit Guardians and Bless
Significantly lower damage and burst healing than Light or Life domains
Poison and psychic domain spells face widespread damage resistance in Acts 2 and 3

uniqueFeature.description: Consuming a Soul Coin empowers her infernal engine, granting +2d4 fire damage to weapon and unarmed strikes when raging or below 25% HP.

recommendedMulticlass: 5 Berserker Barbarian / 4 Thief Rogue / 3 Champion Fighter
optimizationRationale: Tavern Brawler adds double Strength modifier (+10 to +12) to both attack and damage rolls with thrown weapons. Berserker unlocks Enraged Throw (a bonus action that knocks targets prone with no saving throw). 4 levels of Thief Rogue grant Fast Hands (an extra bonus action every turn), enabling two Enraged Throws per turn. 3 levels of Champion lower critical threshold to 19 and provide Action Surge. When Karlach consumes a Soul Coin, her Infernal Engine adds an extra 2d4 fire damage to every attack, producing over 160 DPR with zero spell slot expenditure.

builds.name: Evocation Wizard (Sculpt Spells Master Blaster)
builds.description: Gale's canonical high-artillery specialization. Sculpt Spells completely protects party members from friendly-fire AoE, and Empowered Evocation adds +INT damage to every single Magic Missile dart.
strengths: Sculpt Spells allows firing massive Fireballs and Otiluke's Freezing Spheres directly onto engaged allies with zero damage risk
Empowered Evocation adds +INT modifier (+5) to every Magic Missile dart, yielding 50-80 guaranteed unavoidable Force damage
Can learn and scribe every Wizard scroll in the game, granting unparalleled tactical spell repertoire versatility
drawbacks: Squishy d6 hit die makes Gale vulnerable to focused alpha-strikes if caught without Shield spell
Heavy long-rest dependency: rapid expenditure of Level 5 and 6 spell slots burns through camp supplies
Lacks native armor proficiencies without human shield racial or specific gear investment

combatLoopBreakdown.bonusAction: Cast Misty Step for evasive positioning or activate Staff of Spellpower Arcane Battery
combatLoopBreakdown.reaction: Shield spell (+5 AC) or Counterspell to shut down hostile enemy magic

builds.name: Abjuration Wizard (Invulnerable Arcane Ward)
builds.classSplit: 10 Abjuration Wizard / 1 White Draconic Sorcerer / 1 Tempest Cleric
builds.description: The legendary immortal tank wizard. Arcane Ward absorbs incoming damage to 0, while upcasted Armor of Agathys and Wet vulnerability redirect 60-120 Cold damage back to attackers on hit.
strengths: Virtually unkillable: Arcane Ward absorbs up to 20+ flat damage per hit, rendering physical hits harmless
Devastating passive damage: enemies hitting Gale take 30-60 cold retaliation from Armor of Agathys (doubled to 60-120 against Wet targets)
Heavy armor and shield proficiency from Tempest Cleric reaches 23+ AC with zero spell slots required
drawbacks: Requires intentional setup: Armor of Agathys must be pre-cast at Level 5 or 6 before entering combat
Smart AI in Honor Mode may actively avoid attacking Gale if his AC is too high, requiring positioning in enemy patrol paths
Slightly delayed high-level Wizard spell progression due to the Sorcerer/Cleric dip

builds.name: Padlock (Frontline Blade of Frontiers)
builds.description: Wyll's pinnacle martial frontline multiclass. Binds heavy pact weapons to Charisma, delivers crushing Divine Smites fueled by short-rest Warlock spell slots, and boosts melee damage with Aura of Hate.
strengths: Full Charisma SAD scaling: Charisma drives melee weapon accuracy, spell save DC, Aura of Protection (+5 saves), and Aura of Hate damage
Devastating burst damage by converting Level 3 Warlock short-rest slots into maximum-tier Divine Smites on critical hits
Heavy armor proficiency combined with Aura of Protection grants top-tier survivability and party defensive auras
drawbacks: Multiclass split delays Level 3 Warlock spells and high-tier smite slots until mid Act 2
Aura of Hate buffs nearby undead and fiends, requiring disciplined tactical spacing against Act 2 shadow foes
Consumes short-rest spell slots rapidly when smiting during consecutive boss phases

builds.name: Sorlock (Eldritch Gatling Cannon)
builds.description: The ultimate ranged sustained artillery. Pairs Agonizing Blast, Repelling Blast, and the Potent Robe with Metamagic to fire 6 to 9 Force beams per round, blasting enemies into environmental hazards.
strengths: Unrivaled sustained single-target ranged DPR: fires up to 9 Force beams per round with Quickened Spell and Haste
Repelling Blast shoves foes back 4.5m per beam (up to 13.5m per action) with zero saving throw, yielding instant chasm kills
Flexible Metamagic lets Wyll Twin-cast high-level buffs (like Haste) or crowd control while maintaining full offensive output
drawbacks: Crucially dependent on Alfira's Potent Robe quest reward in Act 2 to scale damage
Cloth armor user with lower base HP pool requires proactive positioning and Mage Armor
Long rest reliant to convert spell slots into Sorcery Points for continuous Quickened Blast volleys

combatLoopBreakdown.reaction: Shield spell (+5 AC) against incoming projectile attacks or Counterspell to negate enemy AoE

builds.name: Fiend Warlock (Netherese Hellfire Blade)
builds.description: Wyll's canonical pure Warlock progression. Features the Level 12 Lifedrinker invocation adding Charisma modifier twice to melee strikes, 3 Level 5 spell slots recharging every short rest, and Level 6 Mystic Arcanum.
strengths: Three Level 5 spell slots recharging on every short rest ensure unmatched sustainability across lengthy adventuring days
Lifedrinker invocation adds Charisma modifier as bonus Necrotic damage to every melee weapon strike
Hunger of Hadar blinds, slows, and continuously damages enemy choke-points with zero save allowed against the blindness
drawbacks: Strictly capped at 3 spell slots per encounter, heavily punishing miscast spells or wasted counterspells
Lacks the smite burst of Paladin or the Metamagic volume of Sorcerer multiclasses
Medium/light armor baseline requires careful defensive itemization or Armor of Agathys pre-buffing
